{{Quote|Attuned to the Power of the Cosmos, my people traveled the galaxy via Infinity Gates&mdash;portals that transported us instantly between great distances. We observed many worlds and brought civilization to their people.|A'nang|<ref name="DOTJ 8" />}}
'''A'nang''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] before the [[Tho Yor Arrival|First Migration]] of the [[Tythan]]s in the system. As the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] withdrew from [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] and the [[Galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]] at large in the face of [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] aggression, A'nang was one of the few who remained on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. He would be the last of these, and would construct a [[Holocron of A'nang|Holocron]] to pass on his knowledge, which was later found by the [[Je'daii Order]] and activated itself in [[25,793 BBY]], when a [[Je'daii Journeyer]], [[Tasha Ryo]], touched it.
